input.jobDescription:
Senior Backend Engineer at PayRange

PayRange is a payments infrastructure company. We process $2B in transactions annually and are growing our backend team.

The Role:
- Build high-throughput payment processing APIs in Go
- Design event sourcing and CQRS patterns for financial transactions
- Integrate with Visa, Mastercard, and ACH networks
- Ensure PCI DSS compliance across services
- On-call rotation (1 week per quarter)

Required Skills:
- Go (Golang) — 3+ years
- PostgreSQL with strong query optimization skills
- Redis for caching and distributed locks
- gRPC and Protocol Buffers
- Experience with payment systems or financial services

Compensation:
- Base salary: $160,000 – $210,000 depending on experience
- Annual performance bonus up to 20%
- Equity: 0.05% – 0.15% options
- Comprehensive benefits including 401(k) match

Location: New York, NY (hybrid) or remote for senior candidates.

Apply at payrange.com/careers
